meta.display_name: IEEE journals (Editorial Style Manual for Authors)
meta.status_detail: Round 1 (workspace proposal 3674c0c1) migration. Verified 2026-09-11 against the IEEE Editorial Style Manual for Authors PDF (journals.ieeeauthorcenter.ieee.org). heading_numbering_visible was deliberately left unset in the original dict entry rather than forced to True -- section-heading enumeration is explicitly a stated author preference in the manual, not a hard requirement -- and stays absent here.

source.note: In-text references are numbered in square brackets, reference list in citation order (not alphabetical).

Up to four heading levels are specified (Roman numerals / A. / 1) / a)). heading_numbering_visible is intentionally left unset (absent from this file) rather than forced to True: section-heading enumeration is explicitly 'desirable, but not required' per the manual -- a stated author preference, not a hard requirement.
